notes: Lyrics can stick to a track: turn on "Stick to the singer's track", then pick which track under "Belongs to" (or Auto for whoever sings), or just drag the lyrics onto a track in the preview and they latch on. They stay centred on that lane as it moves, with a Freedit's camera too. Also in this update: cleaner videos with no more grain (constant quality), Freedit cameras keep every track in frame when "Tracks can go off the frame" is off, faster short intros, circle pictures fill square intros, and the next singer moves up the moment a take ends.
